audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for painful visit/letter, forgiveness/restoration of offender, adversarial advantage, Troas, fragrance of Messiah, sincerity.

verses.restored: For I judged this for myself: not to come again to you in grief.

familiar.text: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

verses.restored: For if I grieve you, who then makes me glad except the one being grieved by me?

familiar.text: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

verses.restored: And I wrote this very thing, so that when I came I might not have grief from those from whom it was necessary for me to rejoice, having confidence in all of you that my joy is the joy of you all.

familiar.text: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

verses.restored: For out of much pressure and compression of heart I wrote to you through many tears, not so that you might be grieved, but so that you might know the love I have more abundantly for you.

familiar.text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

verses.restored: But if anyone has caused grief, that one has not grieved me, but in part, so that I may not weigh down, all of you.

familiar.text: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

verses.restored: Sufficient for such a one is this rebuke by the majority,

familiar.text: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

verses.restored: so that instead you should rather graciously forgive and comfort/encourage, lest such a one be swallowed by more abundant grief.

familiar.text: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

verses.restored: Therefore I urge you to confirm love toward such a one.

familiar.text: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

verses.restored: For into this also I wrote, so that I might know your tested character, whether you are obedient in all things.

familiar.text: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

verses.restored: To whom you graciously forgive anything, I also; for indeed what I have graciously forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, it is because of you in the face/presence of Messiah,

familiar.text: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

verses.restored: so that we may not be outwitted by the adversarial one, for we are not unaware of its thoughts.

familiar.text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

verses.restored: Coming to Troas for the good news of Messiah, and a door having been opened to me in the Lord,

familiar.text: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

verses.restored: I had no rest in my spirit because I did not find Titus my sibling; but saying farewell to them, I went out to Macedonia.

familiar.text: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

verses.restored: But thanks to the Divine, the One always leading us in triumphal procession in Messiah and making manifest through us the fragrance of his knowledge in every place.

familiar.text: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

verses.restored: For we are aroma of Messiah to the Divine among those being saved/healed and among those perishing:

familiar.text: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

verses.restored: to one, fragrance from death into death; to the other, fragrance from life into life. And who is sufficient for these things?

familiar.text: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

verses.restored: For we are not like the many, peddling the word of the Divine, but as from sincerity, but as from the Divine, before the Divine, we speak in Messiah.

familiar.text: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

translation_notes: Forgiveness/restoration in verses 6-8 is essential: discipline must not swallow the person in grief.
Fragrance/triumph imagery is rhetorically complex; preserve both the vulnerable apostolic role and the manifesting of Messiah's knowledge.
